NOTICE
Date:&nbsp20-05-2020
Subject: -&nbspFormation of Student Academic Grievance Redressal Committee
NOTIFICATION
As per Direction of
the Govt. of Assam, a “Student Academic Grievance Redressal Committee” is
constituted with the following members –
Dr. Bijoy
     Krishna Pachani – Chairperson
Mr. Sunil Kr.
     Bhattacharyya – Vice Chairperson
Dr. Binoy Brat Rajkhowa
     – Member Secretary
Ms. Yasmin Khan –
     Member
Ms. Archana
     Konwar – Member
Mr. Jiban Boruah
     – Member
Ms. Ranju Devi –
     Member
Mr. Nayan
     Baruati – Member
Dr. Bikash Nath –
     Member
Mr. Pranab
     Saikia – Member
Dr. Junti Baruah
     – Member
Mr. Robin Saikia
     – Member
The Committee will
communicate with the students through online methods or, through mobile phone
network or physical contact to solve their academic problems. Member Secretary
will monitor and manage all the necessary activities pertaining to the activities
of the committee.

IQAC.
